simple.summary: מֵמַד (mêmad) means a measure First listed occurrence: Job 38 5.

definitions.full: H4461. memad [ מֵמַד ] noun [masculine] measurement ; — שָׂם מִי מְמַדֶּיהָ Job 38:5 , i.e. of the earth (|| קָ֑ו עָלָיהָ מִינָֿטָה ).
